title_zh: 居业接力 90 天可逆试点协议
authority_note_zh: 本文件定义拟议试点的证据、责任和停止条件，不代表已有运营主体、预算、采购、场地许可、参与者或测试结果。
authority_note_en: This file defines proposed evidence, responsibilities and stop conditions. It does not claim an operator, budget, procurement, site permission, participants or test results.

phases.purpose_zh: 不改变任何资格、合同或空间状态，只复演请求、人工接收、普通路径、撤回和无人接收等情况。
phases.purpose_en: Replay requests, human receipt, ordinary routes, withdrawal and missing receivers without changing eligibility, contracts or space.
permitted_actions: 成本与容量字段采集设计
deliverables: 未知成本容量字段清单
phases.exit_gate: G1 and G2 must both pass; any absent accountable role, ordinary route or withdrawal method is a no-go.

phases.purpose_zh: 仅在获授权、可恢复的样板间或服务台内测试三项产业验证协议和人工接管。
phases.purpose_en: Test three industry-validation protocols and human takeover only in authorized, reversible mock-up or service-desk settings.
permitted_actions: 受控噪声与安全边界测量
默认拒绝设备负向测试
人工与无 AI 成对办理
prohibited_actions: 把样板结果外推为片区成效
phases.exit_gate: G3 requires an accountable receiver, complete raw records, zero unresolved high-severity safety or consent breach, and a tested rollback.

phases.purpose_zh: 由专业人员、使用者代表和运营角色共同判断修订、限定继续、退役或等待更多证据。
phases.purpose_en: Professionals, user representatives and operational roles decide whether to revise, continue within limits, retire or wait for evidence.
prohibited_actions: 在无预算维护责任时扩容
将概念试点写成政府承诺
deliverables: 继续/限定/退役/等待决定
phases.exit_gate: No scaling decision is valid without signed evidence ownership, ordinary-route parity, lifecycle resources and an explicit retirement path.

cost_method.formula: total_lifecycle_cost = approved_personnel_hours * approved_role_rates + authorized_space_cost + equipment_and_calibration_quotes + accessibility_accommodation_quotes + insurance_permit_and_safety_quotes + maintenance_spares + verified_retirement_and_restoration_cost + approved_contingency
cost_method.go_no_go: No pilot opening or scaling until every operand has a named evidence owner, quote or approved rate, lifecycle period and retirement provision.

capacity_method.formula: safe_daily_case_capacity = min(staff_minutes_available / observed_median_case_minutes, authorized_space_slots, verified_no_ai_fallback_capacity, maintenance_and_emergency_capacity)
capacity_method.reporting_rule: Report completed, withdrawn, failed, deferred and no-receiver cases in the denominator and stratify by AI/no-AI, language and reasonable accommodation path.

procurement_and_acceptance.requirement: Use functional, vendor-neutral specifications and the applicable procurement route; no named supplier is a design requirement.
procurement_and_acceptance.block_if: Rights, maintenance, data export, accessibility, interoperability or retirement terms are absent.

procurement_and_acceptance.requirement: Test equipment calibration, offline mode, manual override, replacement parts and data deletion before any operational acceptance.
procurement_and_acceptance.block_if: A demonstration succeeds only under vendor support or a remote service that has no ordinary fallback.

procurement_and_acceptance.requirement: Acceptance separates protocol compliance, safety, public-interest parity, lifecycle cost and field outcomes.
procurement_and_acceptance.block_if: Marketing claims, participant counts or a single successful run substitute for raw records and independent review.

validation_protocols.research_question: Can a non-structural prototype move between declared living/work configurations and return to a jointly accepted baseline without compromising safety or accessibility?
baseline_required: photo/drawing record with rights and consent
egress, fire, structure and accessibility review
validation_protocols.cycle: baseline review -> dry run -> witnessed changeover -> occupied-use observation only if separately authorized -> witnessed restoration
instruments: measuring tools appropriate to the component
proposed_acceptance: no unresolved safety or egress nonconformity
restoration reaches the signed baseline or a new jointly accepted state
resident/user and professional sign-off both present

validation_protocols.name_zh: 住研邻接噪声与安全验证
validation_protocols.name_en: Live-Work Adjacency Noise and Safety Validation
validation_protocols.research_question: Can residential quiet, privacy and ordinary access remain protected beside a controlled research or collaboration prototype?
baseline_required: authorized boundary between domestic and work areas
calibrated ambient-noise baseline at agreed periods
ordinary access, complaint and emergency routes
validation_protocols.cycle: baseline measurement -> closed low-intensity test -> declared operating window -> resident/user review -> joint stop/continue decision
instruments: calibrated sound level meter used by a qualified role
voluntary disturbance diary without diagnostic inference
proposed_acceptance: applicable acoustic and safety thresholds set by qualified reviewers before the test
zero unauthorized crossing into domestic space
ordinary route and complaint channel remain open
negative feedback and non-completion remain visible
stop_rule: complaint cannot be received and acted on

validation_protocols.name_zh: 智能家居门内默认禁入验证
validation_protocols.research_question: Does every private-home device remain non-collecting and ordinary-service capable when consent is absent, withdrawn or the network is unavailable?
validation_protocols.cycle: default-off inspection -> negative network observation -> explicit consent activation -> withdrawal -> deletion and offline fallback -> independent replay
instruments: local network observation appropriate to the device
proposed_acceptance: zero unauthorized transmission while consent is off
withdrawal disables the declared data flow
basic residential and maintenance functions remain available without AI
resident-readable state and deletion receipt are present
stop_rule: ordinary function depends on continued consent
